events.name: MGMA Annual Conference
events.image_alt: Optimax's MGMA 2026 Annual Conference graphic: September 27–30 in San Antonio, booth 433.
events.summary: Connect with Optimax and explore practical support for your practice, from revenue cycle management to coding and credentialing.
events.headline: Meet Optimax at the MGMA Annual Conference
events.intro: Let's talk about your practice. Meet our team at booth #433 to explore revenue cycle management, medical coding, and credentialing support.
events.past_headline: Optimax at the MGMA Annual Conference
events.past_intro: Our team attended the MGMA Annual Conference in San Antonio. If we missed you at booth #433, we'd still love to connect about your practice.
events.body: Every healthcare organization has its own challenges. Connect with Optimax to discuss your billing workflows, coding needs, or credentialing process and explore how our team can help.

topics.title: Revenue cycle management
topics.copy: Talk through collections, denials, and the day-to-day demands of medical billing.

topics.title: Medical coding & auditing
topics.copy: Explore coding support that helps your team work accurately and confidently.

topics.title: Provider credentialing
topics.copy: Discuss support for provider enrollment and credentialing workflows.

events.gallery_alt: Two Optimax team members standing behind the Optimax consulting services booth at an MGMA event.
events.gallery_heading: The people behind your practice support
events.gallery_copy: Get to know the team behind Optimax's billing, coding, and credentialing services. A conversation is a great place to start.
events.cta_copy: Whether we met at MGMA or you're reaching out for the first time, we'd love to hear about your practice.

events.headline: Come See Us at NAMIWalks Kern County
events.intro: Join Optimax on October 17 as we come together with our community in support of mental health awareness. We'd love to see you there.
